query:
SELECT id as "id!: Uuid",
                      device_id as "device_id!: Uuid",
                      tunnel_id as "tunnel_id!: Uuid",
                      accessed_by,
                      ip_address,
                      user_agent,
                      success as "success: bool",
                      created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM tunnel_access_logs
               WHERE device_id = $1
               ORDER BY created_at DESC
               LIMIT $2
